title: Textbook Generation Pipeline Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Open the eight artifacts of the textbook pipeline, then check which artifacts each generated one is built from.

learningObjectives: The learner will identify, for each of the seven generated artifacts of the textbook pipeline, which of the other seven artifacts it is built from, with at least 6 of 7 exactly correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Chapter Structure and Chapter Content are stored in the same file. Explain how that can be true when one is built from the other.
commonMisconceptions: The chapters are written directly from the course description without a learning graph.
The glossary is written from the chapters rather than from the concept list.
A MicroSim is built from the course description rather than from a specification inside a chapter.
